en.title: Hunger Games Prequel Conquers UK Box Office, 'Ramayana' Makes History
en.summary: The latest installment in **The Hunger Games** saga, **Sunrise on the Reaping**, has roared to the top of the U.K. and Ireland box office. Meanwhile, **Ramayana: Rise of a Legend** has etched its name in the history books as the highest-grossing Indian film in the territory.
en.body:
The dystopian world of Panem has once again captured the imagination of audiences, this time in the U.K. and Ireland. **The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping**, the latest prequel to the massively popular franchise, has debuted at the number one spot, raking in an impressive £13.04 million ($17.01 million) including previews. This strong opening solidifies the franchise's continued dominance at the box office and its ability to draw crowds to cinemas.

Opening in second place, and setting a remarkable record of its own, is **You Can See Everything**, the documentary from directors **Nathan Fielder** and **Lance Oppenheim**. The film, distributed by A24, opened with $3.2 million, marking the biggest opening for a documentary in U.K. box office history. This achievement underscores a growing appetite for compelling non-fiction storytelling and the power of unique directorial voices.

## A Tale of Two Box Office Victories

The U.K. and Ireland box office saw a fascinating mix of established global entertainment and significant cultural milestones this past weekend. **The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** secured its top position with a reported £9.9 million from its opening weekend, pushing its total to £13 million. This prequel, which delves into the early days of the Hunger Games, clearly resonated with fans eager to explore more of the **Suzanne Collins**-created universe.

Simultaneously, **Ramayana: Rise of a Legend** continued its remarkable run, adding £338,000 in its third weekend to bring its total to £4.8 million. This milestone not only signifies a successful run for the film but also makes it the highest-grossing Indian film of all time in the U.K. and Ireland. It surpassed previous record-holders like **Dhurandhar: The Revenge** and **Pathaan**, demonstrating the increasing reach and impact of Indian cinema on the international stage.

## Fan Frenzy and Future Prospects

The success of **The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** is a testament to the dedicated global fanbase that has followed Katniss Everdeen's story and its prequel narratives. The film's ability to open so strongly, especially in the face of other significant releases, speaks volumes about the franchise's enduring appeal and its ability to connect with new generations of viewers, while also satisfying long-time fans.

The record-breaking performance of **Ramayana: Rise of a Legend** is a cause for celebration for the South Asian diaspora and film enthusiasts worldwide who champion diverse cinematic voices. It signals a positive trend for international films finding wider audiences and achieving significant commercial success outside their home markets.

## What's Next

Audiences can continue to experience **The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** and **Ramayana: Rise of a Legend** in cinemas across the U.K. and Ireland. Further box office figures for both films will be closely watched as they continue their theatrical runs.
